title: Implement eight-child centre-query source codes
body:
This construction stores the complete eight-coordinate centre query in eight existing source fields of the historical complex supplier. The target still receives its original clean-J operation, all 480 arbitrary borrowed helpers are restored, and the code adds **eight rank-one native children and no array field**. The enabling theorem also characterizes every source automorphism whose target correction stays on the same eight ports.

**The complete kappa bound is unchanged.** This resolves a local source-encoding obstacle. The output query fields retain their individual native frames; a complete supplier must still restore the source across routed cover charts and pay for all access, precision, hosting, and recursive work.

Evidence: [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59/research/native-source-codes/PROOF.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59/research/native-source-codes/certificate.json), [cold replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59/research/native-source-codes/evidence/REPLAY.json), and [independent agent review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59/research/native-source-codes/REVIEW.md).

For `J=I-KR`, choose dyadic matrices with `RP=LK=I` and `LP=0`. Then

```text
Z=K-P(RK-I),  Q=R-L,
RZ=LZ=I,  QZ=0,  JZ=-P(RK-I).
```

Thus `G=I+ZQ` is invertible, `LG=R`, and its target correction is supported on P. Applying `X+=JZQY` and `Y=GY` at the actual input gives the complete local map `(X-JY,GY,h,0)`. This uses the common input source frame instead of restricting the source response to an internal cut. No inverse of 13 is used.

When P occupies exactly eight ports with a dyadic-unit R minor, `ker J_offA=im Z`. Hence the full fixed-support source group is `G=I+ZB`, with dyadic invertibility equivalent to that of `I+BZ`. Composition keeps the eight-port native support; scalar cost can grow. The package gives a streamed logger and inverse, plus a non-diagonal eight-snapshot code and inverse.

| Local word | Complete scalar allowance | Existing private fields used |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Query logger | 218794 | 1 |
| Inverse source code | 218794 | 1 |
| Non-diagonal source code | 222846 | 8 |
| Inverse non-diagonal source code | 225794 | 8 |

Each word has complete original-rank profile `{1:2420, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82}`, of mass 5530, versus retained mass 5522. The eight new children have 16 explicit binary address maps. The scalar column counts real-component primitives per array coordinate; it does not include their complete compiler, recursive, or precision cost. Used private fields end at zero. The inverse preludes restore persistent inputs; a full backward call is not its inverse prelude.

The exact base is [`bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f). Inputs come from the frozen [PR #1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042) [source archive](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/community-frontier1042-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz), also used by the historical [PR #1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) assembly. All consumed objects and credit sources are pinned in [SOURCES.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59/research/native-source-codes/SOURCES.json). This PR does not depend on an unmerged PR.

With Python 3.10 or later, Git, and that base object in the local repository, run from its root with a new output directory:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/native-source-codes/replay.py \
  --repo . --out /tmp/native-source-codes-review
```

Expected output:

```text
PASS_INPUT_ONLY_SOURCE_CODES
All 712 formal input columns and 4096 new native Gaussian columns passed.
The complete supplier and kappa calculation are unchanged.
```

Root and independent cold replays passed. Independent review reconstructed all four streams and checked arbitrary helper contents, private lifetimes, frame access, prelude inverses, composition, and exact scalar counts. Exact Gaussian checks cover all 512 basis inputs for each new native recipe, including its scalar phase. Negative controls reject missing compensation, wrong signs and phases, and a premature source scatter with the same event multiset, cost, and legal frames. The 5056 retained native events stay in order; their source-bound native dependencies are stated in the review. Global routing and restoration, complete supplier pricing, and a new kappa calculation were not established. No complete supplier or repository-wide suite was run for this local addition.

The retained [gauge notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots-t16/NOTICE.md) credits @icekylinx. The [t16 notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots-t16/t16/NOTICE.md) credits Hao Yan (@FanPUYen) for integration, Jeremy Kothe (@jeremykothe2) for the [PR #799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/799) local supplier, and Chafik Boukhalfa (@chafreaky) for the [PR #741](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/741) frame work. The [slot-word source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots/README.md) credits @rohanarun for [PR #987](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/987) and NewBArch for [PR #869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/869); no account is inferred for NewBArch. Exact notices and further lineage remain in [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59/research/native-source-codes/NOTICE.md). The loader and replay tools share the campaign's source work with [PR #1719](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1719), without requiring that PR to merge.

Related mutable-source work is Hanson Sun’s (@bbMisk) [PR #1522](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1522). Its [pinned proof and scope](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2/research/shared-dyadic-source/README.md) share a restored source-query tour across distinct BIT outputs under an exclusive mutable-source contract. This package uses the complex input interface and a fixed-support source automorphism. It consumes none of that package’s code or certificate.

New research, implementation, and independent agent review used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance under the user's direction. No independent human review is claimed. New material uses Apache-2.0. The [open next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59/research/native-source-codes/README.md) specify the remaining restoration and chart-transition constructions.
